method: numerical search of this atlas: orbit elimination for the subgroup C3 (rotations about an axis through a vertex) with code/sym_elim.py, moment equations reduced to the C3-invariant subspace, nodes kept in the closed domain, started from the fully symmetric rule CA-T3-28-1181-PI-MPC; proven with tools/verify_rigorous.py
author: Claude (Anthropic), commissioned and directed by Joerg Kubitz
